question: Where can I find a hotel within a 110 kilometers search radius in the west direction?
sql: WITH hotel_centroid AS ( SELECT ST_Centroid(ST_Collect(geometry)) AS center_point FROM pois WHERE tourism = 'hotel' ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois AS p, hotel_centroid AS hc WHERE p.tourism = 'hotel' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, hc.center_point::geography, 110000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(hc.center_point, p.geometry)) BETWEEN 247.5 AND 292.5;
